subject: 清初至清中北方大院（原创扩展；具体细部待考）
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Texture and detail this architectural blockout into one realistic early-to-mid Qing north China manor courtyard map sprite. CRITICAL pixel-locked orthographic camera: keep EXACT same ground-contact outer quadrilateral and straight base edges as input. Do NOT reposition, enlarge, or recenter layout. On1536x1024 canvas left ground corner remains(188,540), foreground(828,860), right(1348,600), rear(708,280). Width16m depth13m, L-F=(640,320), F-R=(520,-260). Both planar axes slopes+0.5 and-0.5, no perspective convergence. The geometric silhouette is immutable. Replace flat blocks with realistic fine aged gray brick, small matte charcoal-gray hard-gable roof tiles, dark brown timber lattice doors/windows, plain stone paving. Prosperous northern domestic courtyard, one-story rear domestic hall and two short wings, a modest recessed brick front doorway. All roofs gray, no royal green/yellow tiles, no painted palace beams or gilding. Fine realistic historical construction, naturally restrained weathering and dense tiled/brick details for high-resolution Chinese RPG map, not cartoon/low-poly. Keep the foreground perimeter a SINGLE STRAIGHT LINE, no zigzag, no projecting step or doorstep; place steps entirely inside. Same fixed camera, same level rectangular ground footprint, upright verticals; only architectural surface/detail changes. Upper-left sun, minimal short lower-right contact shadow. Transparent RGBA outside building, fully opaque building interior. No surrounding scenery/floor, fog, halo, bloom, glow, background, text, logo, people or modern objects. Anonymous original northern historical interpretation, not a named monument. All tips visible with clear margins.
